newsitem.title: USA: Sierra Pacific agrees to Nevada refund.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Pacific agrees to Nevada refund.

text.p: Sierra Pacific Power Co, the staff of the Public Service Commission of Nevada and the Office of Consumer Advocate submitted a stipulated proposal to the commission calling for a $13 million refund to Nevada electric customers and a decrease of $7.1 Million in electric prices, followed by a freeze in northern Nevada electric, natural gas, fuel and purchased power prices to January 2000.

In addition, the utility said Wednesday, the stipulated proposal calls for a 50/50 sharing between shareholders and ratepayers of all earnings in each of the gas and electric divisions above 12 percent return on equity.

The Sierra Pacific Resources Corp subsidiary said the agreement also provides an opportunity, subject to certain conditions, to apply any return above 12 percent to buying down or buying out of long-term fuel and purchased power contracts currently in place.
The commission will examine the proposal at a hearing Wednesday and is expected to issue a ruling or order concerning it at a commission agenda hearing on February 6.
